coverage_rule: Exchange matching is partial and only covers explicitly verified addresses in this registry. No unmatched destination may be inferred as an exchange.

rules.USDT: Confirmed transfers from verified Tether Treasury address. Only destinations matching verified exchange registry count as Treasury->Exchange.
rules.USDC: Zero-address mints are issuer mint destination proxy; they are not labeled Circle Treasury. Only verified exchange destinations count as Mint->Exchange.
rules.no_inference: Unmatched addresses are never classified as exchanges.
rules.stablecoin_supply: Stablecoin supply increase is not equivalent to actual crypto spot buying.
